question: Does the fixed12month own economic-return sign, traded at monthly decisions with unchanged local risk budget and execution, produce positive net results and add beyond matched-intent long exposure?
mechanism: Existing trend family: delayed adjustment/persistent demand is a hypothesis. Local counterparty identities are unavailable. Negative funding can also drive the input, so net funding and price cash components must be separate; neither attribution nor original paper proves the payer hypothesis.
null: No robust positive net and closed PnL plus increment over same-opportunity magnitude-long control at both registered costs.
target_rule: At each monthly00UTC anchor use only that frozen top10 opportunity set. For N selected members, unit-intent weight=sign(prior12calendar-month economic index return)*.16/(N*prior annual economic-return volatility); if gross unit weights exceed1 scale all proportionally to1. The existing engine then multiplies unit weights by gross.8, so nominal16percent is before that overlay. No forecast-strength ranking, learned normalization, floor, zero-day filling or intramonth signal refresh. The control is the absolute value of that same target book. Actual exposure, stopping and realized risk may differ.
risk_contract: Keep8percent original ratcheting position stop,15percent persistent account drawdown halt,10positions,1percent actual5mquote participation proxy. Rebalance only at monthly anchors; stops/lifecycle exits remain intraday and can shorten nominal one-month holds. No intramonth reentry after stop except already pending same-anchor execution. No cross-year reset, leverage or risk-budget search.
paper_deviations: Perpetual economic index includes actual reported funding; cashyield0,365calendar risk days,finite12month COM60 history with normalized population variance,16percent nominal risk before .8 overlay,top10 crypto liquidity domain,fees/slippage and stop/halt rules. These are declared local adaptations, not fullpaper replication. No inherited paper returns.

statistics.scope: Known-history diagnostic only;20nonoverlapping monthly decisions with correlated assets, not400independent observations.32day paired intervals descriptive,128day insufficient; full historical search correction and unseen/external evidence remain missing.

decision: Research followup only if principal netANDclosedPnL>0,net increment over long>0,maxDD<=.15,nohalt for bothcosts and bothsources. If base followup fails stop this frozen implementation; do not tune horizon/risk/stop or choose sources.
